crossRefs.note: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.
Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a…
I gave my back to those who beat me, and my cheeks to those who plucked off the hair. I didn’t hide my face from shame…
Just as many were astonished at you— his appearance was marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of…
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he didn’t open his mouth. As a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a…
Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge…
They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.
For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.
They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

translations.web: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.
translations.bsb: Then they spit on Him and took the staff and struck Him on the head repeatedly.
